places.name: Piazza Gae Aulenti
places.connection: The modern architecture of Piazza Gae Aulenti inspired some of the futuristic designs in the game.

places.name: CD Projekt Red Headquarters
places.connection: This is the main studio where Cyberpunk 2077 was developed.

places.name: Warsaw Spire
places.connection: The architecture of the Warsaw Spire influenced the design of some buildings in Night City.

places.name: Los Angeles
places.connection: Los Angeles served as a major inspiration for the setting of Night City in Cyberpunk 2077.

places.name: Edo (now Tokyo)
places.connection: Tokyo's urban landscape and neon aesthetics influenced the visual style of Cyberpunk 2077.
